data.name: label9.Text
data.value: PUP Sta. Maria offers both theoretical knowledge and practical skills. Applied activities aligned with current industry practices help students gain experience. The programs are designed to prepare graduates for employment or starting their own business.

data.name: label6.Text
data.value: The campus follows the core values of PUP. It delivers industry-relevant education that prepares students for real work environments. Graduates are trained to think critically, solve problems, and contribute to national and community development. PUP Sta. Maria supports holistic student growth through academic services, guidance programs, and community projects that promote social awareness.

data.name: label4.Text
data.value:
The Polytechnic University of the Philippines Sta. Maria Bulacan Campus was officially established in 2003 as part of the university's expansion program. The campus was created to bring quality and affordable education closer to communities in Bulacan. Since 2003, to the increasing demand for college education in Sta. Maria and nearby towns.
Since its founding, PUP Sta. Maria has played a key role in local education, promoting inclusive education and equal access to learning.

data.name: label2.Text
data.value: The Polytechnic University of the Philippines Sta. Maria Bulacan Campus (PUPSMB) was established in 2003 as part of the university's expansion program. Its primary goal is to provide quality and affordable higher education to the communities of Sta. Maria and nearby areas in Bulacan, reducing the financial burden of pursuing a degree.
